title: Expand dataflow.json ontology with data items and mentions
description:
Purpose: Make a data item a first-class graph thing. A mention/span is evidence (file + lines), not the data item itself. Data items can belong to components and ride data flows.

Keep terms: component, data flow, data item.
For a line use mention, evidence, or span. Not "data item reference."

Definition of done: stories specify observable graph behavior; schema work waits on those specs.
